cast.characterName: マーゴット＝エディス・ヴィラ・アヴァロン
cast.originalCharacterName: マーゴット＝エディス・ヴィラ・アヴァロン

segments.text: An honest and good girl. She is the de facto crown princess because her eyes are a "noble violet" color, which is proof that she should have the throne. Although she looks a lot like the former empress Ursula, she has a much kinder personality.

She was secretly moved to the "Cape Mansion" because she was a target from the moment she was born. There, she was raised by Erin. She worries about finally returning to the Imperial City for the first time in 12 years, reuniting with her father, and about becoming the next empress.
Translated from official website

cast.characterName: ジェラルド＝エリク・アヴァロン
cast.originalCharacterName: ジェラルド＝エリク・アヴァロン

segments.text: Margot's half-brother. He is a quiet, intelligent boy who cares about his sister. Since he did not inherit the blood of the former emperor Ursula, he has no right to succeed to the throne.

In order to protect Margot, who is always in danger of assassination, the "Kage no Ken" follows her without leaving her side for even a moment. Although he possesses unimaginable combat skills considering his age, he is still too inexperienced to handle the task alone. For now, he is fulfilling his mission as a "Ken" together with his teacher Erin.
He has no doubts about his fate of protecting his sister for the rest of his life.
Translated from official website

cast.characterName: ロディス・カスタニエ
cast.originalCharacterName: ロディス・カスタニエ

segments.text: The eldest son of the Duke of Castagnier. His father Serge, the current head of the family, has renounced his right to succeed to the throne, so he is currently third in line. At his father's request, he studied abroad in the neighboring region since he was a child. He is Margot's second cousin, but they don't know each other. He is a gentle and kind young man.
Perhaps because he has lived in Tokkal for a long time and is unfamiliar with life in Euro, he feels a strong sense of incongruity about Euro's current political system and aristocratic society.
Translated from official website

The "Kage no Ken" who once protected Ursula, the former empress. After Ursula died, he took care of Margot and her younger brother Gerald at "Cape Mansion" as Margot's guardian. Also, in order to make Gerald a full-fledged "Ken", he has strictly trained Gerald since he was a child.

In interpersonal combat, he boasts high abilities that can be said to be invincible, and because he is always calm and collected, he tends to be seen as a cool-headed person. However, he is sweet only to Margot.
From his appearance, he seems to be a person of blood close to the Imperial House of Avalon, but...
Translated from official website

cast.characterName: ベネディクト＝エイミス・ハミルトン
cast.originalCharacterName: ベネディクト＝エイミス・ハミルトン

segments.text: Margot's uncle. The younger brother of the former empress Ursula. He was unable to obtain the throne for the reason that he did not have the "noble violet color", and was later ordered by his grandfather Adolph to establish a branch family, the Duke of Hamilton. There are rumors that he and Ursula had a feud prior to her death, although the truth has never surfaced.

He currently holds the second place in the line of succession to the throne, but if Margot has a child, his rank may drop. In order to oppose it, it is said that he openly expands his power through political marriages with influential nobles. In aristocratic society, he is famous as a hobbyist who loves art.
Translated from official website

cast.characterName: ゲオルグ・アヴァロン
cast.originalCharacterName: ゲオルグ・アヴァロン

segments.text: Margot's father. Husband of the former empress Ursula. Since he is from the commoner class, he does not have the right to succeed to the throne himself, but until Margot comes of age and ascends to the throne, he manages the affairs of Euro as the Archduke Regent of Avalon. His marriage to Ursula was big news at the time, but it seems that some nobles still look down on him as a commoner.

His wife died 12 years ago, and around the same time he had the misfortune of being forced to relinquish his daughter to a distant land to protect him from assassins. Since then, he has never seen Margot again.
Translated from official website

cast.characterName: アーシュラ＝オルガ・ヴィラ・アヴァロン
cast.originalCharacterName: アーシュラ＝オルガ・ヴィラ・アヴァロン

segments.text: She is the former empress of Euro and Margot's mother.

Like Margot, she had a "noble violet" her eyes. For this reason, her grandfather and the emperor at the time, Adolph, deposed her father Eberhard of Ursula from her crown and made her her crown prince instead.
After a chance encounter and a passionate love affair with Georg, the son of a merchant family, she got married. She later gave birth to Margot, then died tragically shortly after giving birth.
Born with a weak body, she later lost sight in one eye and hearing in one ear, but it is said that she had a lively personality throughout her life.
Translated from official website
